svg.title: Four adjacent S2 L10 cells and their Hilbert orientations
svg.desc: Canonical parents 808581, 808587, 808f7d and 808f7f drawn through one shared Web Mercator projection so they join along their real S2 edges. Every cell shows its full L13 traversal; 808581 draws its selected cells heavy and its L12 run light, while the other three keep a solid L12 run.
